trainer.dialogueBefore: Bird Keeper Katherine: My Noctowl spotted you long before you reached this slope. Let's battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Bird Keeper Katherine: It saw you coming. It just couldn't keep up with you.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ninja Boy Nick: A talking rock? No, a ninja! And a ninja never refuses a battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ninja Boy Nick: Back to sitting very still and being a boulder, then.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Sean: Up and down this slope all day long, that's my training. You'll be my rest stop!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Sean: Some rest stop. I'm more worn out than when I started.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ruin Maniac Harry: Bronzor were first dug up in ancient ruins, you know. I've three! Care to see them?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ruin Maniac Harry: All three of them, polished off like old mirrors in a museum.

signs.trainer_tips_signpost:
Trainer Tips
Mountains are long and their caves are dark. Fill your bag with Potions and an Escape Rope or two before you head in!
